title: Procedure File: 2026/0265(COD) | Legislative Observatory | European Parliament

triage.reason: The Commission published legislative proposal COM(2026)0590 for a Public Procurement Regulation on 9 September 2026, a concrete new legislative step within the 60-day window, though the excerpt gives no plastics-specific detail.

draft.summary: The European Parliament's Legislative Observatory procedure file for 2026/0265(COD) lists meetings with interest representatives published in line with the Rules of Procedure, including a meeting on 14 October 2026 with Fairtrade Labelling Organizations International e.V. It also lists meetings on 13 October 2026 with Upphandlingsmyndigheten and on 9 October 2026 with LO Sverige.
